The Board of Architectural Review met in a work session in the Vienna Town Hall, 127 Center Street, South Vienna, Virginia, Thursday, September 1, 2022, at 8 pm.  

The following members were present: Chairman Roy Baldwin, Paul Layer, Michael Cheselka, Linda van Doorn, and Patty Hanley.

Staff present: Director David Levy and Planner Sharmaine Abaied.

Applicants: Dave Hallett and Keith Leonard from RRMM- Architects 
                   Maryam Mostamandi and Jun Li from Fairfax County 

The applicants presented a preliminary Concept Design for the new Patrick Henry Library and associated parking garage located at 101 Maple Avenue East.
 
The Board review the proposed changes and made the following recommendations:

• Brick colors 
• Addition of design elements to protect pedestrians
• Courtyard Trellis changes
• Break up the massing
• Integration of garage into design
• Addition of pedestrian entrance to garage from Center St.
• Possibility of triple glazed windows for exterior
• Addition of sloped roofs
• Addition of some screening
• Narrow planting strip added to the left side of the garage where possible
• Working with a landscape architect to update the streetscape concepts 
• Recessed bricks
• Consideration of a brick banded sidewalk
• Consideration of flush dry laid brick for sidewalk


Respectfully submitted by,
Yaska Camacho Castillo
Board Clerk
EventItemTitle: Board of Architectural Review (BAR) work session on the Concept Design for the proposed new Patrick Henry Library and Parking Garage.
